CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/42.0.23
export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT

# Resolve conflict 1 (.PHONY line), conflict 2 (test-harnesses-12 line), conflict 3 (target definition)
# Use python via heredoc to avoid quoting issues with very long lines

python3 <<'PY'
import re

with open('Makefile', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find conflicts and resolve them
# Conflict pattern: <<<<<<< HEAD\n...\n=======\n...\n>>>>>>> sha (msg)\n
def resolve_conflict(match):
    head_side = match.group(1)
    feature_side = match.group(2)
    
    head_lines = head_side.strip().splitlines()
    feature_lines = feature_side.strip().splitlines()
    
    # Conflict 1 & 2: .PHONY line or test-harnesses-12 line
    # Both sides are single lines. Feature added test-emit-design-plan-preview (removed test-check-plan-size).
    # Upstream kept test-check-plan-size. Resolution: feature line + insert test-check-plan-size.
    
    if len(head_lines) == 1 and len(feature_lines) == 1:
        head_line = head_lines[0]
        feat_line = feature_lines[0]
        
        has_check_plan_size = 'test-check-plan-size' in head_line and 'test-check-plan-size' not in feat_line
        has_emit_preview = 'test-emit-design-plan-preview' in feat_line and 'test-emit-design-plan-preview' not in head_line
        
        if has_check_plan_size and has_emit_preview:
            # Insert test-check-plan-size after test-emit-design-plan-preview in the feature line
            resolved = feat_line.replace(
                'test-emit-design-plan-preview',
                'test-emit-design-plan-preview test-check-plan-size'
            )
            return resolved
    
    # Conflict 3: multi-line target definition
    # head side: test-check-plan-size target
    # feature side: test-emit-design-plan-preview target
    # Both are new targets — keep both
    if any('test-check-plan-size' in l for l in head_lines) and any('test-emit-design-plan-preview' in l for l in feature_lines):
        # Keep feature side first, then head side
        return feature_side.strip() + '\n' + head_side.strip()
    
    # Fallback: keep both
    return head_side.strip() + '\n' + feature_side.strip()

pattern = re.compile(r'<<<<<<< HEAD\n(.*?)\n=======\n(.*?)\n>>>>>>> [^\n]+\n', re.DOTALL)
resolved = pattern.sub(resolve_conflict, content)

conflicts_remaining = resolved.count('<<<<<<<')
print(f"Conflicts remaining: {conflicts_remaining}")

with open('Makefile', 'w') as f:
    f.write(resolved)

print("Done")
PY

grep -n '<<<<<<\|=======\|>>>>>>>' Makefile || echo "no markers"

echo "test-emit-design-plan-preview occurrences: $(grep -c 'test-emit-design-plan-preview' Makefile)"
